title: Lisse condensed cohomology on w-strictly local affines depends only on components
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For a scheme $X$ put $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use internal module sheaves and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. A finite-rank lisse module means one locally isomorphic on a pro-etale cover to a finite free $\Lambda_X$-module, with rank allowed to vary [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. Let $h:X'\to X$ be a morphism of affine schemes whose coordinate rings are w-strictly local [sk-def-pe-wlocal]. Assume the induced map on profinite component spaces
$$\pi_0(h):\pi_0(X')\xrightarrow{\sim}\pi_0(X)$$
is a homeomorphism, where components have the quotient topology [lem-pe-spectral-components-profinite]. For every finite-rank lisse $\Lambda_X$-module $M$, the canonical pullback of derived sections is an isomorphism
$$R\Gamma(X,M[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(X',h^*M[0])$$
in the ordinary derived category of abelian groups [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Here $R\Gamma$ is the total right derived functor of evaluation at the final object, followed by forgetting scalars; the displayed map is induced by the actual adjunction unit $M[0]\to Rh_*h^*M[0]$. It is natural in $M$ and in commutative diagrams of such morphisms, using the canonical pullback composition comparisons. No completeness, discreteness, Noetherianity, or extremal disconnectedness of the component spaces is assumed.
